runs.content: Wednesday's rotation focus is Health + Learning. Since the last thinker run (2026-09-01), log.md shows zero new activity of any kind — no trades, no clippings, no new pages in any domain. Health's pages (overview, my-protocol, the two source pages) are unchanged since May, so the deep-dive turned to Learning's framework pages and person-seth-godin.md, cross-checked against the full wiki map for connections outside today's pair. Two genuinely new, non-duplicate finds: (1) Buffett's 'concentrate your effort and ruthlessly avoid the rest' principle is written down three separate times in the wiki with no cross-links — [[finance/ideas/idea-berkshire-principles]]'s Principle 5 ('A Few Winners to Work Wonders,' synthesised from four Berkshire letters), [[learning/source-buffett-525-rule]]'s sharper 'Avoid-At-All-Cost list' framing from an unrelated career-advice anecdote about Buffett and his pilot, and [[learning/altmba-freds-work]]'s own P12 breakthrough ('Mediocre is OK') where Fred independently arrived at the identical insight about his own career in 2018. (2) [[learning/framework-abn-analysis]]'s whole diagnostic method — is a boundary self-imposed/narrative or genuinely real/structural? — maps directly onto the actual structure of disagreement in [[work/source-workday-disruption-debate-2026]]: a16z's Schmidt treats Workday's moat as self-imposed and breakable by AI agents, while LaRocque and Turnbull argue the real boundary is regulatory/structural (compliance accountability, config framework). ABN's own Cross-References table lists Finance, Crypto, Games and Lightfin as domains to apply it to but omits Work entirely, and neither page cites the other. No new investigation idea cleared the bar today — Health and Learning's pages were checked against the existing Open Investigation Ideas list and turned up nothing not already logged — and nothing in the existing open sections showed signs of resolution.

Tuesday's rotation focus is AI & Tech + Technology, but neither domain has gained a new page since 2026-08-27, and log.md since the last thinker run (2026-08-31) shows almost no activity: a routine portfolio-management-briefing (no trades executed), a spinoff-monitor run (0 new candidates, just status updates on already-tracked names), and a single new ingest — books/book-breath.md, created today by the book-summarizer catch-up from Fred's reading list (read 2026-08-03). That last item produced the day's one genuinely new, non-duplicate find: [[health/source-godin-breathwork-2026]] (ingested 2026-05-15) explicitly names its own source in its metadata — 'Referenced book: Breath: The New Science of a Lost Art — James Nestor' — and its Mechanism section leans entirely on 'Nestor's research' as the evidentiary basis for the whole page. The newly-created [[books/book-breath]] independently restates the identical material (nasal vs. mouth breathing, ancient techniques anticipating modern science, breath as a stress-reduction lever) but its See Also section links only to reading-list.md and suggestions.md — nothing points back to the Health page it directly underlies, and the reverse link doesn't exist either. Logged as a new cross-domain connection (concrete next step: cross-link book-breath.md to health/source-godin-breathwork-2026.md and health/my-protocol.md, and add a reverse link from the source page's Cross-References). No new investigation idea cleared the bar today — AI & Tech/Technology's overview pages and recent source pages were checked against the rest of the wiki-map but turned up nothing not already logged in the existing Open Investigation Ideas list — and nothing in the existing open sections showed signs of resolution.
